create_ResultStat_instance: create a ResultStat instance with a batch key and optional tensorboard log root directory
feed_ResultStat_batch: feed a batch dictionary with reward values to the ResultStat instance to accumulate win and loss counts
reset_ResultStat_counters: reset the win and loss counters on the ResultStat instance back to zero
log_ResultStat_winrate: log the current win rate to tensorboard and return a formatted summary message for the given epoch
get_ResultStat_num_games: get the total number of games played by accessing the num_games property on the ResultStat instance
